resources.string: Back up Homika to Google Drive or keep a portable file copy.
Back up to Google Drive after every business-data change. Nearby changes are combined into one upload.
Sign in to Google in Account first to enable automatic Drive backup.
Backup pending · Homika will retry automatically
Google Drive backup uses the Google account in More → Account. Drive Sync does not need to be enabled.
%1$d Homika records were backed up directly to Google Drive.
%1$d Homika records were saved to the selected backup file.
Connect Google Drive Sync first, then try again.
Google Drive needs authorization again. Try the action once more and approve access when asked.
Google Drive could not be reached. Your Homika data remains local and automatic backup will retry.
Homika could not access its private backup area in Google Drive.
No Homika Google Drive backup exists yet. Create a Drive backup first.
